name: WPEye
author: Rafal Dziwinski

sections.description:
This plugin checks if your WordPress installation is secure. It checks basic rules, inspired by Wazuh policies.
If there is any red light, your WordPress installation is insecure.
If all lights are green, you can’t be 100% sure that your website is impossible to hack, but it will be really, really hard.

External services

This plugin uses the php.net website to get a list of supported PHP versions.
